prompt.generated_prompt_string: Using the attached adult reference image as mandatory identity and environment source, create an even 2x2 grid of four dramatic photorealistic mid-close cinematic portraits. Preserve the person's exact identity, face, age presentation, hairstyle, and key features in every panel. Show four different confident natural poses and dynamic wide-angle viewpoints, using perspective only to reveal the environment rather than to exaggerate body parts. Expand the original environment conservatively, retaining its recognizable materials, lighting logic, palette, and spatial character. Apply cinematic lighting, controlled contrast, crisp natural textures, and consistent color grading across all panels. Preserve any source text only if it is clearly present; otherwise add no text, logo, or watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, identity change, face swap, age alteration, public figure, celebrity likeness, minor, child, body-part exaggeration, sexualized pose, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, duplicate person, extra limbs, deformed, inconsistent panels, text, logo, watermark
